semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports consumed ICU78.3 UDate, millis-per-day and status predicates/constants. Negative warnings remain successful; positive statuses remain failures. Other ICU error constants, compiler/platform declarations and generic export machinery are not ported. Adds original U_INDEX_OUTOFBOUNDS_ERROR8 for the actual resource iterator exhaustion contract, independently observed in the native iterator comparison. Other unconsumed status constants remain outside this partial declaration. Adds original U_STRING_NOT_TERMINATED_WARNING(-124) and U_BUFFER_OVERFLOW_ERROR15 for actual termination/checked-buffer contracts; no invented locale error codes are introduced. Native primitive/keyword facade comparisons verify exact statuses and warning clearing.
